standard.summary: 源图 latent 对当前 noisy latent
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: How strongly the source latent acts on the current noisy latent
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 源图 latent 对当前 noisy latent 的残差注入强度。建议从 0.20-0.30 起试（默认 0.25，范围 0~1）。

advanced_en.principle: Strength of residual injection from the source-image latent into the current noisy latent. Start with 0.20-0.30 (default 0.25, range 0~1).
